section_summary: This section consists chiefly of declarations by Swiss banks and custodians identifying dollar-denominated Japanese government, municipal, and company bonds, their owners’ nationality and residence, and where the securities were held. It includes two copies of a bank-by-bank tally, repeated copies of several declarations, and a State Department memorandum forwarding 64 declarations to the U.S. Political Adviser in Tokyo.

subfiles.title: Union de Banques Suisses bond announcement
subfiles.about: Declares Tokyo Electric Light bonds owned by a French national living in Monaco.
subfiles.summary: Lists $6,000 in Tokyo Electric Light bonds held through a Paris bank’s Limoges branch.

subfiles.title: Union de Banques Suisses Oriental Development announcement
subfiles.about: Declares Oriental Development bonds belonging to Greek nationals living in Switzerland.
subfiles.summary: Lists two $10,000 groups of Oriental Development bonds held in the bank’s vaults.

subfiles.title: Union de Banques Suisses electric power announcement
subfiles.about: Declares Great Consolidated Electric Power bonds held for French and Swiss interests.
subfiles.summary: Lists $3,000 of 1924 bonds and $3,000 of 1925 bonds, with differing owners.

subfiles.title: Union de Banques Suisses mixed bond announcement
subfiles.about: Declares several Japanese company bonds owned by Swiss nationals.
subfiles.summary: Lists Oriental Development, Tokyo Electric Light, and Great Consolidated Electric Power holdings.

subfiles.title: Union de Banques Suisses Bern declaration
subfiles.about: Reports company bonds with Swiss and Italian owners.
subfiles.summary: Lists Great Consolidated Electric Power, Tokyo Electric Light, and Oriental Development bonds.

subfiles.title: Union Bank of Switzerland Zurich statement
subfiles.about: Lists Japanese company dollar bonds beneficially owned by Swiss nationals.
subfiles.summary: Identifies bonds held in Zurich, Chiasso, and New York.

subfiles.title: Leu & Cie declaration of Japanese company bonds
subfiles.about: Lists Japanese company bonds held for Swiss persons and entities.
subfiles.summary: Includes Nippon, Tokyo, Daido, Oriental Development, and Taiwan Electric Power bonds held in Switzerland, New York, and Buenos Aires.

subfiles.title: Leu & Cie Swiss-resident holdings declaration
subfiles.about: Reports Oriental Development and Tokyo Electric Light bonds held in Switzerland for Swiss residents.
subfiles.summary: Lists $3,000 and $1,000 holdings.

subfiles.title: American Express custody declaration
subfiles.about: Certifies Oriental Development bonds owned by Eugenia Oser-Osiander.
subfiles.summary: States that $1,500 in bonds had belonged to the Swiss owner since before September 1939.

subfiles.title: Swiss National Bank Geneva announcement
subfiles.to: U.S. authorities via the Swiss Legation
subfiles.about: Declares Great Consolidated Electric Power bonds owned by a Swiss resident.
subfiles.summary: Lists $7,000 in bonds and states uninterrupted ownership and custody since before September 1939.

subfiles.title: Swiss National Bank Basel declaration
subfiles.about: Reports a City of Tokyo bond held for a Swiss individual.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond deposited since October 1931.

subfiles.title: Banque Cantonale Vaudoise announcement
subfiles.about: Identifies Daido Denryoku bonds owned by Léonie Vernet-Aubert and Gustave Bonnard.
subfiles.summary: Lists the two Swiss owners’ bonds and addresses.

subfiles.title: Banca Popolare di Lugano securities announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Swiss-owned Tokyo Electric, City of Tokyo, and Japanese government bonds.
subfiles.summary: Lists $2,000, $20,000, and $40,000 holdings.

subfiles.title: Schaffhausen bank Japanese issue notification
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese government bond held for a Swiss resident.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 1935–1965 sinking fund bond.

subfiles.title: St. Gallen Cantonal Bank representation letter
subfiles.about: Submits a Tokyo Electric Light bond for representation of a Swiss owner living in Italy.
subfiles.summary: Reports one $1,000 bond lodged in New York.

subfiles.title: Du Pasquier, Montmollin Japanese government bond certificate
subfiles.about: Certifies Swiss ownership of a 1930–1965 Japanese government bond.
subfiles.summary: States continuous Swiss ownership since December 1941.

subfiles.title: Du Pasquier, Montmollin Taiwan bond announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Taiwan Electric Power bonds deposited in Neuchâtel.
subfiles.summary: Lists nine $1,000 bonds with coupons attached.

subfiles.title: Oriental Development Swiss ownership certificate
subfiles.about: Certifies Swiss ownership of an Oriental Development bond since before September 1939.
subfiles.summary: The damaged text identifies one $1,000 1928–1958 bond.

subfiles.title: Lombard, Odier 1965 government bond declaration
subfiles.about: Declares a Japanese government bond for a nonenemy resident of Switzerland.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond held through J.P. Morgan in New York.

subfiles.title: Lombard, Odier Swiss-owned 1965 bonds declaration
subfiles.about: Declares three Japanese government bonds owned by a Swiss resident.
subfiles.summary: Lists $3,000 held through J.P. Morgan in New York.

subfiles.title: Lombard, Odier 1954 government bonds declaration

subfiles.summary: Reports bonds in its vaults and through J.P. Morgan in New York.

subfiles.title: Lombard, Odier Oriental Development declaration

subfiles.title: Lombard, Odier Oriental Development holdings declaration
subfiles.about: Declares $8,000 in Oriental Development bonds owned by Swiss residents.
subfiles.summary: Lists eight bonds held through J.P. Morgan in New York.

subfiles.title: Hentsch & Cie Japanese company bond announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Swiss-owned Oriental Development and Great Consolidated Electric Power bonds.
subfiles.summary: Lists three groups of Japanese company dollar bonds; OCR of several amounts is damaged.

subfiles.title: Bordier City of Tokyo bond announcement

subfiles.summary: Lists four $1,000 bonds held through Dominick & Dominick in New York.

subfiles.title: Bordier Japanese government bond announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government bonds owned by Swiss and French residents of Switzerland.
subfiles.summary: Lists $2,000 for Swiss owners and $1,000 for a French owner.

subfiles.title: Ferrier Lullin Japanese company bond letter
subfiles.about: Reports company bonds held for Swiss residents.
subfiles.summary: Lists $10,000 in Great Consolidated Electric Power and $5,000 in Oriental Development bonds.

subfiles.title: SAGED Spanish-owned bond declaration
subfiles.from: S.A. de Gérances et de Dépôts
subfiles.about: Declares Japanese government bonds held for a Spanish resident of Spain.
subfiles.summary: Lists $4,900 held through J.P. Morgan in New York.

subfiles.from: S.A. de Gérances et de Dépôts
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government and Great Consolidated Electric Power bonds for Swiss residents.

subfiles.title: SAGED Swiss owner abroad declaration
subfiles.from: S.A. de Gérances et de Dépôts

subfiles.summary: Lists six $1,000 bonds.

subfiles.title: SAGED nonenemy foreign owner declaration
subfiles.from: S.A. de Gérances et de Dépôts
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government bonds for a nonenemy foreign resident of Switzerland.
subfiles.summary: Lists two $1,000 bonds held at National City Bank of New York.

subfiles.title: Banque Charles Perreau Swiss-owned securities announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government and Oriental Development bonds of Swiss ownership.
subfiles.summary: Lists $3,200 and $3,000 holdings.

subfiles.title: Armand von Ernst Oriental Development declaration
subfiles.about: Distinguishes Swiss individual ownership from an English-owned Swiss finance company’s bonds.
subfiles.summary: Lists $3,000 in 1953 Oriental Development bonds for Swiss residents and $125,000 in 1958 bonds for a Swiss financial company whose shares are owned by people in England.

subfiles.title: Banque Populaire Suisse Tokyo Electric announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Swiss-owned Tokyo Electric Light bonds.

subfiles.title: Banque Populaire Suisse Lucerne securities inquiry

subfiles.summary: Lists a $1,000 Japan Electric Generation bond and a $500 government bond.

subfiles.title: Bern Cantonal Bank Oriental Development letter
subfiles.about: Reports an Oriental Development bond held for a Swiss national.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond held in the bank’s vaults.

subfiles.title: Bern Cantonal Bank Tokyo Electric letter
subfiles.about: Reports a Tokyo Electric Light bond held for a French national.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond.

subfiles.title: Bern Cantonal Bank Spanish-owned Oriental Development letter
subfiles.about: Reports Oriental Development bonds held for a Spanish national.
subfiles.summary: Lists $10,000 in 1958 bonds.

subfiles.title: Basel-Country Cantonal Bank declaration
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government and Tokyo Electric bonds owned by Swiss residents.
subfiles.summary: Lists $1,000 and $2,000 holdings.

subfiles.title: Zahn & Cie Tokyo Electric declaration
subfiles.about: Certifies uninterrupted Swiss ownership of Tokyo Electric Light bonds.
subfiles.summary: Lists three bonds held by Brown Brothers Harriman in New York since 1932.

subfiles.title: Lüscher & Cie Japanese bond announcement
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government bonds belonging to Swiss and French owners.
subfiles.summary: OCR is damaged; the clear copy on page 217 lists $5,000 Swiss-owned and $1,000 French-owned.

subfiles.title: Bank-by-bank tally of declarations
subfiles.about: Summarizes Swiss banks’ declarations of Japanese dollar securities.
subfiles.summary: A three-page bank-by-bank tally lists company, government, and municipal bonds by issue and amount. It totals $689,285 and records 63 declarations prepared in four copies each.

subfiles.title: Swiss Bank Corporation securities letter
subfiles.about: Lists Swiss-owned Japanese company bonds for transmission to U.S. authorities.
subfiles.summary: Itemizes Great Consolidated, Taiwan Electric, Tokyo Electric, Oriental Development, and Ujigawa Electric bonds.

subfiles.title: Swiss Legation inquiry fragment
subfiles.about: Asks whether declarations may also cover Japanese government and local government securities.
subfiles.summary: The surviving page contains the end of an inquiry made at the Swiss Federal Political Department’s request.

subfiles.title: Zahn & Cie Tokyo Electric declaration copy
subfiles.about: Repeats the declaration of Swiss-owned Tokyo Electric Light bonds.

subfiles.title: Pictet & Cie Gabrielle Chauvet-Ador declaration

subfiles.summary: Lists two $500 bonds held with J.P. Morgan since before September 1939.

subfiles.title: Bonhôte Japanese government bond announcement

subfiles.title: Bonhôte Great Consolidated bond announcement

subfiles.title: Banca Unione di Credito Oriental Development schedule

subfiles.summary: Lists ten $1,000 bonds.

subfiles.title: Gonet & Co Oriental Development announcement

subfiles.title: Union Bank of Switzerland Winterthur list

subfiles.title: Union Bank of Switzerland Basel letter

subfiles.title: State Department forwarding memorandum

subfiles.title: Lüscher & Cie Japanese bond announcement copy
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese government bonds held for Swiss and French owners.
subfiles.summary: Lists $5,000 for a Swiss resident and $1,000 for a French resident, deposited in London.

subfiles.title: Bank-by-bank tally of declarations, second copy
subfiles.about: Repeats the tally of Swiss bank declarations and Japanese dollar securities.
subfiles.summary: The second three-page copy again itemizes banks and bond issues, totaling $689,285. It records 63 declarations in four copies each.

subfiles.title: Crédit Suisse Neuchâtel Taiwan declaration

subfiles.title: Swiss Bank Corporation securities letter copy

subfiles.title: Union Bank of Switzerland Ujigawa statement

subfiles.title: Banque Populaire Suisse Lucerne declaration, further copy

subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond.

subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond; the OCR year conflicts with the earlier copy.

subfiles.summary: Lists $10,000 in bonds.

subfiles.about: Repeats the Swiss-owned Japanese government and Tokyo Electric bond declaration.

subfiles.about: Repeats the declaration of a government bond for a Swiss national abroad.

subfiles.title: SAGED English entity declaration copy
subfiles.from: S.A. de Gérances et de Dépôts
subfiles.about: Repeats the declaration of electric power bonds for an English legal entity.

subfiles.title: SAGED nonenemy owner declaration copy
subfiles.from: S.A. de Gérances et de Dépôts

subfiles.summary: Lists $2,000 held in New York.

subfiles.title: Banque Charles Perreau announcement copy
subfiles.about: Repeats the Swiss-owned Japanese government and Oriental Development bond announcement.
subfiles.summary: Lists $3,200 and $3,000 holdings.

subfiles.title: Banque de l’État de Fribourg bond notice
subfiles.about: Reports an Oriental Development bond owned by an American company.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond.

subfiles.title: Du Pasquier, Montmollin government bond certificate copy
subfiles.about: Repeats the Swiss ownership certificate for a Japanese government bond.
subfiles.summary: Lists one $1,000 bond.

subfiles.title: Du Pasquier, Montmollin Taiwan bond announcement copy

subfiles.summary: Lists nine $1,000 bonds.

subfiles.summary: States continuous Swiss ownership of nine bonds since December 1941.
